page_title: RAY 2-2 MAL | Rayo Vallecano v Mallorca 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+12' 2 - 2 Goal! Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Predrag Rajkovic into right side of the goal.
90+12' Rayo Vallecano will get another bite of the cherry as the referee indicates the penalty must be taken again!
90+11' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) misses the penalty! He fired the ball towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper pulled off a tremendous diving save to deny him.
90+11' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+10' The referee shows the yellow card to Omar Mascarell (Mallorca).
90+10' The Rayo Vallecano players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

90+8' There's a break in play and referee Mario Melero Lopez must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Rayo Vallecano using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+7' Surely that's handball by one of the Mallorca players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+6' Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mario Melero Lopez had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' Here comes the VAR decision and Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) is back in the game after the red card is downgraded to a yellow!

90+4' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano), but referee Mario Melero Lopez must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+4' It's like he was asking for a caution. Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) receives a yellow card.
90+4' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) is unfairly sent off!
90+2' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+2' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
90+1' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) launches a cross from the corner, but Predrag Rajkovic is alert to thwart the effort.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
87' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Darder leaves the pitch and Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) comes on.
84' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post.
83' Mario Melero Lopez shows a yellow card to Sergi Darder (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
82' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
80' Substitution. Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Alfonso Espino.
79' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) comes close as his long-range free kick goes a whisker over the crossbar.
76' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
74' A cooling break is underway.
74' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged offside.
73' Chance! Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but Predrag Rajkovic is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.

72' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
71' Predrag Rajkovic reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) towards the bottom right corner.
71' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
71' Francisco decides to make a substitution. Aridane Hernandez will be replaced by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
68' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
67' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:4.
64' The referee signals a substitution. Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Abdon Prats.
64' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a change. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) replaces Antonio Sanchez.

63' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
62' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kike Perez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch for Unai Lopez.
60' Francisco prepares a substitution. Sergio Camello is replaced by Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano).

59' 1 - 2 Goal! A terrific long pass from Sergi Darder picks out an unmarked Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
55' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.

52' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Predrag Rajkovic was alert and the score remains the same.
51' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
51' The free kick from long range, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Toni Lato (Mallorca) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
46' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle and it's Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle as Abdon Prats (Mallorca) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45+3' Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul after Samu Costa (Mallorca) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Mario Melero Lopez to decide. The relieved Mallorca players can finally celebrate.
44' Wait! Referee Mario Melero Lopez immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
44' 1 - 1 Goal! Abdon Prats connects with the free kick and heads it into the path of Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), who makes no mistake and puts it into the net. 1:1.
43' A long-range free kick is awarded to Mallorca.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Mario Melero Lopez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) unleashed a brilliant free kick from the edge of the box and hits the left post of the goal.
36' Rough tackle by Samu Costa (Mallorca). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' The ball possession is 67:33.

33' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Stole Dimitrievski. This effort didn't really trouble him.

32' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
27' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
26' There's an opportunity for Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

26' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.
22' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mario Melero Lopez saw the whole situation.
20' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul.
17' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Great teamplay by Rayo Vallecano as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
13' Dangerous play by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano). Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Toni Lato (Mallorca) comes onto the pitch after Jaume Costa signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
8' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
7' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is flagged for offside.

4' 1 - 0 Goal! Sergio Camello displays great vision and sends a pass to Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Rayo Vallecano will kick-off.
Mario Melero Lopez will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
